en: A monochrome postcard view of a street corner with a large ornate school building on the right, labeled above the entrance as an elementary school. People are walking near the entrance and along the tree‑lined street, with mountains visible in the background. The caption along the bottom border identifies the scene as the girls' schools on Via Cavour in Rovereto.
